Commentary: Henry Crocombe, right-arm fast medium, comes into the attack

H Crocombe to Kusal Mendis, no run, 132.5ks delivery on middle. Kusal Mendis is on the back foot trying to defend a delivery that was supposed to be played on the front foot. He manages to keep it out
H Crocombe to Kusal Mendis, 1 run, Kusal Mendis drops it in front of mid-on and scampers for a quick single. They make it home in time
H Crocombe to Avishka Fernando, FOUR, slot delivery from Henry Crocombe. Avishka Fernando clears his front foot and pumps it over wide mid-on. Sri Lanka need more of these
H Crocombe to Avishka Fernando, FOUR, this helps. Back-to-back boundaries. Angled into the pads, Avishka Fernando helps it down to fine leg with a pull. Bounces just inside the ropes at fine leg
H Crocombe to Avishka Fernando, no run, good length delivery on middle and leg. Defended to the on-side

H Crocombe to Avishka Fernando, FOUR, good over for Sri Lanka. Not an ideal start to Henry Crocombe's spell. Full on middle and leg, Avishka Fernando whips it off his pads and picks up his third boundary of the over

Drinks are on the field! Sri Lanka lost an early wicket which put them on the back foot, but Avishka and their skipper have kept their heads down and marched on at six runs an over to stay in the chase. It will be an interesting phase for both teams as to how they take the game forward from here.
Liam Dawson to Kusal Mendis, 1 run, tossed up delivery on leg, Kusal Mendis clips it towards backward square leg for a single
Liam Dawson to Avishka Fernando, no run, this one grips into the surface slightly, Avishka Fernando defends it into the off-side
Liam Dawson to Avishka Fernando, THATS OUT!! Caught!!

Liam Dawson to Avishka Fernando, out Caught by Will Jacks!! That was a pretty good shot by Avishka Fernando, but he finds the fielder at wide long-off. Was timed pretty well as he was down the wicket to play the lofted drive, however, Jacks at wide long-off charges across to his left and takes a well judged catch in the outfield. Avishka Fernando falls just two runs short of a well deserved fifty. Liam Dawson is pumped up as the England players charge towards him and celebrate with him. Avishka Fernando c Will Jacks b Liam Dawson 48(50) [4s-8 6s-1]
